user.title: Smarting HOME — Choose License
user.description:
Welcome to Smarting HOME Energy Management!

Choose your license mode:
• **FREE** — All sensors, autopilot with the Max Zysk arbitrage planner, schedules, voltage guard, basic alerts
• **PRO** — AI (advisor, reports, AI autonomy), weather strategy, calibrated PV forecast, SMS/e-mail alerts, complaint & invoice reports, automatic updates

Buy PRO at {website} — after payment the license key arrives by e-mail within 24 hours. You can start with FREE now and activate the key later in the Smarting HOME panel (⚙️ Settings → License).

license.title: Smarting HOME — License Activation
license.description:
Paste the Smarting HOME PRO license key from the order e-mail (it arrives within 24 hours of payment).
No key yet? Buy one at {website} — or choose FREE now and activate the key later in the Smarting HOME panel (⚙️ Settings → License).

brand.title: Marka falownika
brand.description:
Wybierz markę falownika. Na tej podstawie zostaną ustawione domyślne sensory.
Zawsze możesz je ręcznie zmienić w następnym kroku.

Bez fotowoltaiki (dom lub firma tylko z licznikiem)? Wybierz „Brak falownika” — integracja nie będzie niczym sterować, a w menu pojawi się panel „Energia i koszty”. Licznik w rozdzielnicy (Shelly EM / 3EM / Pro 3EM, Eastron SDM przez Modbus) podłączysz tam: Ustawienia → „Wykryj licznik”.

tariff.title: Konfiguracja taryfy
tariff.description:
Wybierz taryfę energetyczną.
Ceny G13: Pozaszczyt {g13_off_peak}, Poranny szczyt {g13_morning}, Popołudniowy szczyt {g13_afternoon}

ai.title: Doradca AI (Opcjonalnie)
ai.description:
Skonfiguruj dostawców AI do inteligentnej optymalizacji energii.
Pozostaw puste, aby pominąć.

sensors.title: Mapowanie sensorów
sensors.description: Przypisz encje sensorów falownika. Domyślne ustawienia wypełniają się na podstawie wybranej marki (GoodWe, Deye, Growatt, Sofar Solar).

upgrade.title: Smarting HOME — Settings & Upgrade
upgrade.description:
You are on the FREE plan. Paste the PRO license key from the order e-mail to unlock all features — you can also activate it in the Smarting HOME panel (⚙️ Settings → License).
Buy at {website} — the key arrives by e-mail within 24 hours of payment.

data.license_key: 🔑 PRO License Key (leave empty to stay FREE)

api_keys.title: 🔑 API Keys — AI Advisor
api_keys.description: Enter your API keys for the AI energy advisor. Get your Gemini key from Google AI Studio and your Claude key from the Anthropic Console.

downgrade.title: 🔓 Remove PRO license
downgrade.description:
After confirming:
• The PRO license key is removed from this installation
• The integration switches to the FREE plan
• PRO features (AI, weather strategy, SMS/e-mail alerts, reports) are disabled — features this installation had in FREE before version 1.71 stay

To activate PRO again, enter the key in the options or in the Smarting HOME panel (⚙️ Settings → License).
